title: Fast-forward master to the completed deployment history
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: И как теперь вернуться в master и не потерять всё, что мы делали в других ветках?

scope.goal: Move local master and origin/master forward to the complete committed history currently anchored at 922c2b0232450cf3b95d2b64a5d183c94834a029 on codex/reference-average-available-windows, including only the mandatory approval checkpoint added for this operation, preserve the other refs and stash entries, and leave master as the checked-out branch for subsequent work.
inScope: Record and push the mandatory approval-only contract checkpoint as a direct descendant of verified clean source commit 922c2b0232450cf3b95d2b64a5d183c94834a029, without any product-file change.
Fast-forward local master from 02b13813aa2157e69c3a313b4bc86712dea9c674 to that approval checkpoint on codex/reference-average-available-windows.
Push the resulting local master to origin/master without force.
Leave the main worktree checked out on master with upstream origin/master.
Verify committed-history containment and exact local/remote ref equality after the push.
outOfScope: Changing, deleting, merging, rebasing, or force-updating any codex/* branch except advancing codex/reference-average-available-windows by the mandatory approval-only contract checkpoint.
Editing product source, tests, documentation, configuration, or existing commit contents; only mandatory requirement/context/history bookkeeping is permitted.
Creating a merge commit, rewriting history, force-pushing, cherry-picking, squashing, or deleting refs.
Deploying or restarting the service, or reading or mutating Production data.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exactly the 140 existing committed descendants after 02b13813aa2157e69c3a313b4bc86712dea9c674 through 922c2b0232450cf3b95d2b64a5d183c94834a029, followed only by mandatory bookkeeping commits for this operation; no other historical commit range.
scope.firstVerification: Confirm a clean worktree, exact equality of the local deployment branch with its upstream, master-only/source-only counts of 0/140, and merge-base equal to the current master tip before moving any ref.

requirements.text: Move master to the complete committed source history using fast-forward only, with no history rewrite or synthetic merge commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Before mutation, the worktree is clean, codex/reference-average-available-windows equals origin/codex/reference-average-available-windows at 922c2b0232450cf3b95d2b64a5d183c94834a029, and master...source divergence is exactly 0/140.
The approved contract is committed separately as a direct child of 922c2b0232450cf3b95d2b64a5d183c94834a029 before master moves, and that checkpoint changes no product file.
git merge --ff-only advances local master to exactly that approval-checkpoint commit.
No merge commit, rebase, cherry-pick, squash, reset, force operation, or commit-content change occurs.

verification.command: git merge-base master codex/reference-average-available-windows; git rev-list --left-right --count master...codex/reference-average-available-windows; git merge --ff-only codex/reference-average-available-windows
verification.expected: The pre-contract preflight merge-base is the old master tip and divergence is 0/140; after the approval-only checkpoint, local master advances by fast-forward to that checkpoint with no product-file change in the checkpoint.

requirements.text: Publish the complete fast-forwarded history to origin/master and leave master as the branch used for subsequent work.
acceptanceCriteria: A normal non-force push updates origin/master to the fast-forwarded approval checkpoint, and final mandatory bookkeeping is committed and pushed directly on master.
The checked-out branch after completion is master and its configured upstream is origin/master.

Immediately after the fast-forward push, local master, origin/master, codex/reference-average-available-windows, and origin/codex/reference-average-available-windows resolve to the approval checkpoint; after final bookkeeping, local master and origin/master resolve to the same final commit and contain that checkpoint.

verification.command: git push origin master; git status --porcelain=v1 --branch; git rev-parse master origin/master codex/reference-average-available-windows origin/codex/reference-average-available-windows
verification.expected: The push succeeds without force; immediate checkpoint equality is verified; after final bookkeeping the worktree is on clean master tracking origin/master, both master refs are equal, and they contain the approval checkpoint.

requirements.text: Preserve every existing side branch and stash entry while moving master.
requirements.sourceQuote: не потерять всё, что мы делали в других ветках
acceptanceCriteria: No local or remote codex/* branch is deleted; no codex/* branch moves except codex/reference-average-available-windows advancing by the mandatory approval-only checkpoint.
The standalone codex/reference-average-partial-24h ref remains present; it is not merged because its v4 behavior has been superseded by the v5 history already in the source branch.

verification.command: Compare git for-each-ref refs/heads/codex refs/remotes/origin/codex and git stash list snapshots taken before and after the fast-forward.
verification.expected: Every pre-existing codex/* ref except the explicitly allowed approval-only source-branch advance retains the same object ID, and stash@{0} retains object ID 94b5b3c21613947d490d5874d89bb9c0d1df6d62.
